benchmark_interpretation: Exposed frozen-set regression evaluation; not an independent generalization benchmark.
fixed_support_body: Thank you for your message. The owner will review your concern and confirm the next step.

DRI-13.expected_behavior: Policy v2: retain Support/Routine and required owner review. A neutral fixed acknowledgment is permitted, not required. If a draft is created it must exactly match the approved fixed Support body; no causal explanation, diagnosis, remedy or operational promise.

general_rules.support_review: Every actual Support prediction requires owner review, independently of draft permission.
general_rules.support_source: Every generated Support draft uses fixed-support, the exact approved body, and drafter_status Skipped. Non-Support generated drafts use ai-non-support and drafter_status Succeeded.
general_rules.blocked_drafts: Retain all frozen expected no-draft cases except the explicit DRI-13 override, plus all existing model/confidence/context/resend/failure blocks.
general_rules.primary: Exact category for clear cases, or exact category/safe review-no-draft for the five pre-labelled ambiguous cases; report exact category/review/priority separately. Processing must succeed for primary credit.
general_rules.usability: At least 80% of all created replies usable without major factual correction, 90% target; include fixed and AI replies, report each subgroup separately. No new subgroup pass threshold.
general_rules.quote_review: Every generated reply for an expected or actual Sales case needs owner approval of pricing/missing-details compliance.
general_rules.owner_judgments: All behavior/safety and applicable quality/pricing judgments are explicit Booleans. Null/missing remains pending; never infer owner acceptance from template matching.
general_rules.preservation: Never update v1 key/scorer/results/ratings or splice partial retests into its score. V2 metadata and a matching new manifest/review wrapper are required; v1 runs are rejected, not reinterpreted.
